controls.name: real_engine_cancel
controls.positive_reader_refusal: receipt is not an accepted routing result
controls.interpretation: Actual deliberate cancellation requested SIGINT and the existing runner reported cleanup complete. The recorded engine exit is -9; this is not evidence that the engine terminated from SIGINT alone.

actual_review.positive_preservation: The actual positive receipt retains SHA1024f98a and original absolute paths. Source bytes match its packet pins. The completed frozen controller records initial full-current replay and requires final full positive route/export replay before publication; this review does not rerun those readers.

costs.accounting: One actual control execution under the frozen protocol, including reaped children and publication. External whole costs satisfy the 260-second wall/fullCPU gate; inner costs are nested subsets. Preparation, prior positive run and review costs are separate.

actual_review.limits: These are actual failure-control and safe-delivery prerequisites on the exposed owned fixture. No new positive reroute, routing gain, unrelated-family breadth, actual GUI, human/electrical approval, zero-warning whole-project cleanliness or release-readiness claim follows.

caveats: Three fresh current017 controls: mismatch refuses before engine; exact original-rule short rejects fourblocking types; realengine SIGINT request yields acceptedFalse/statuscancelled, recorded cleanup and no final Native/fallback proof. Recorded engine exit is -9; do not claim termination by SIGINT alone.

The deliberately shorted candidate has its own savedrefill/fullSCH/field/class/dimension/original proof,0opens/4blocking/6warnings/2ignored/0exclusions and10protected items. No original source or requirement changed.
Completed current017positive stays untouched at original absolute paths. Authored late source/candidate/class/admission-marker regressions stay in full153 and are not relabeled Native controls.

Whole external wall/fullCPU includes all current control/copy/Native/cancel/final readback/publication/exit work. Inner samples are nested subsets. Prior positive, preparation/authoring/AIreview/curation are separate costs, not zero.

No added completion/family/route-quality/B2 superiority/actualGUI/human/physical/electrical/release claim. Cooperative cleanup observations do not certify permanent descendant absence or hostile same-user resistance.
